Title: Persist & save meetings to local storage
Description: Save each meeting (audio reference, transcript, notes, metadata) to a local SQLite database so it survives an app restart. Foundation for search, memory and templates.

Title: Meeting library / history view
Description: A list or timeline of past meetings; open one to view its transcript and notes.

Title: Full-text search across transcripts & notes
Description: Instant keyword search over every saved meeting.

Title: Organize meetings (folders, tags, by person/date)
Description: Group and filter saved meetings.

Title: Editable rich-text notes
Description: Let users edit and format the notes; changes persist.

Title: Human-in-the-loop notes (jot then AI enhances)
Description: User jots rough notes during the meeting; the AI expands them using the transcript. The core Granola/Char interaction pattern.

Title: Note templates (1-on-1, sales, interview, standup, lecture)
Description: Selectable, customizable summary templates per meeting type.

Title: Custom vocabulary / jargon dictionary
Description: Names, acronyms and jargon that improve transcription accuracy — and works in any language, unlike Granola.

Title: Recording controls (pause/resume, discard)
Description: Pause and resume, discard a recording, and handle interruptions cleanly.

Title: Remove temporary debug logging
Description: Strip DebugLog.swift and the debugLog() calls that were left in the code before finalizing.

Title: Zero-config setup: embed & auto-download models
Description: Bundle or auto-download the Whisper and LLM models so users never touch Ollama or a terminal. Key advantage over rough open-source tools.
Project: v1 · Phase 2 — Make it a product

Title: Native-Mac polish: menu-bar app, global hotkey, onboarding
Description: Menu-bar presence, a global start hotkey, and a clean first-run onboarding flow.
Project: v1 · Phase 2 — Make it a product

Title: Privacy indicator (nothing leaves your Mac)
Description: A visible signal showing what stays local versus what is switched off. Turns privacy into a feature users can see.
Project: v1 · Phase 2 — Make it a product

Title: Export (Markdown, PDF, clipboard)
Description: Export or copy notes and transcript out of the app.
Project: v1 · Phase 2 — Make it a product

Title: Opt-in BYO-key LLM toggle
Description: Optional setting to route summaries through a frontier model using the user's own API key. Off by default; proves the hybrid model and covers the local-quality gap.
Project: v1 · Phase 2 — Make it a product

Title: Swap ScreenCaptureKit for a Core Audio process tap
Description: Move to audio-only capture to remove the recurring Screen Recording permission prompt.
Project: v1 · Phase 2 — Make it a product

Title: Developer ID notarization & distribution setup
Description: Sign, notarize and package the app for distribution outside the App Store.
Project: v1 · Phase 2 — Make it a product

Title: Ask the meeting (local Q&A over transcript)
Description: Answer questions about a past meeting locally — e.g. what did we decide about pricing.

Title: Cross-meeting knowledge memory
Description: Recall people, recurring topics and decisions across meetings. Char's memory layer, local.

Title: Semantic search (local embeddings)
Description: Find meetings by meaning, not just keywords, using on-device embeddings.

Title: Reshape / regenerate summary
Description: Regenerate a summary shorter, longer, or in a different tone or format.

Title: Draft follow-up (copy-out)
Description: Generate the follow-up email or message from the meeting; user copies it out, nothing is sent automatically.

Title: Morning brief / daily digest
Description: A daily summary of open action items and upcoming meetings.

Title: Action-item tracking across meetings
Description: A running task inbox that spans meetings.

Title: Inline suggestions
Description: Contextual suggestions such as task rollover, recurrence and delegation.

Title: Calendar & Contacts integration
Description: Pull meeting titles and attendees; use contacts for better speaker labels.

Title: Obsidian / Notion export
Description: Push notes into the user's knowledge base.

Title: Slack / Gmail actions
Description: Actually send the follow-up or post the summary. True external actions — the heaviest, and last.

Title: Encrypted cross-device sync (Mac to iPhone)
Description: Sync meetings between devices with end-to-end encryption. Requires infrastructure.

Title: In-person mode (single-mic diarization)
Description: Separate two speakers sharing one microphone in the same room, not just calls.

Title: Auto-detect meetings (Zoom/Meet/Teams)
Description: Notice a call has started and offer to record it.

Title: Apple-Silicon tuning (MLX / Neural Engine)
Description: Optimize models for speed and battery on Apple Silicon.
